_notice: Editable starting-point guidance for creative planning. NOT a statement of any platform's current advertising policy. Always check the platform's own rules before publishing.
universal_checklist: Every factual or performance claim is backed by evidence you hold.
No fabricated reviews, testimonials, or endorsements. Testimonial-style scripts are labelled fictional or filled in by a real customer.
Words/claims your brand asked to avoid do not appear.
Music, fonts, footage and any third-party assets are licensed for advertising.
Required ad / AI-content disclosures for your region and platform are added.
The current advertising policies of the target platform have been checked.

instagram_reels.label: Instagram Reels
instagram_reels.caption_guidance: Short first line that works before the 'more' cut-off, then 1-2 lines of value, then CTA.
instagram_reels.cta_placement: Spoken near the end plus on-screen text and caption.
instagram_reels.hashtag_strategy: 3-8 specific hashtags mixing niche and broad.
checklist: Key text sits inside safe zones away from UI overlays.

facebook_video.label: Facebook video ad
facebook_video.visual_format: Vertical 9:16 or square 1:1, captions burned in
facebook_video.caption_guidance: Primary text up front with benefit and offer; keep the link headline short.
facebook_video.cta_placement: On-screen end card plus the ad's CTA button.
facebook_video.hashtag_strategy: 0-3 hashtags; they matter less than copy.
checklist: Offer terms in the ad match the landing page.

youtube_shorts.label: YouTube Shorts
youtube_shorts.caption_guidance: Keyword-led title plus a short description with the CTA link.
youtube_shorts.cta_placement: Spoken in the last third plus pinned comment or description link.
checklist: Title is accurate and not clickbait.

tiktok.label: TikTok-style short
tiktok.visual_format: Vertical 9:16, native handheld feel, on-screen text
tiktok.caption_guidance: One punchy line plus a question or prompt to comment.
tiktok.cta_placement: Mid-video soft CTA and a clear end CTA.
checklist: Trending audio, if used, is cleared for commercial use.
Looks native rather than like a polished TV ad.

website_video.label: Website promotional video
website_video.visual_format: Horizontal 16:9 or responsive, clean and brand-led
website_video.caption_guidance: Short descriptive caption suitable for the page and for accessibility.
website_video.cta_placement: End screen plus an on-page button beside the video.
website_video.hashtag_strategy: Hashtags are not needed; provide keywords for page SEO instead.
checklist: Video file size is optimised for page load.
